data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.current_title: 经济学家：中国AI三大优势，如何重塑全球要素格局？
current_title_lines: 如何重塑全球要素格局？

subtitles.zh: 我认为中国在这场AI变革中或许有三个独特优势。
subtitles.en: I think China has maybe three unique advantages in this AI revolution.

subtitles.zh: 第一是应用落地、真实场景和非常广泛的用户基础。
subtitles.en: Number one is that you say it's adoption and real world scenarios and very broad users.

subtitles.zh: 第二可能是成本效率很高，开源模型、开放权重模型。
subtitles.en: Number two is maybe, you know, it's very cost-efficient, the open source model, open weight model.

subtitles.zh: 第三是基础设施和能源容量。
subtitles.en: Number three is infrastructure and then the energy capacity.

subtitles.zh: 传统上，如果发生重大技术变革，它会改变许多东西，改变你看待资源的方式。
subtitles.en: So traditionally, if you have a big technology revolution, it changes many things, it changes the way you look at resources.

subtitles.zh: 例如，第一次工业革命让煤炭变得非常重要。第二次则让它极其重要。
subtitles.en: For example, you know, the first industrial revolution make co- very important. Second, make it extremely, very important.

subtitles.zh: 我认为当前这一轮，不仅芯片重要，电力也再次变得重要。
subtitles.en: I think that's just the current one we make, you know, not only chips important, but also electricity important again.

subtitles.zh: 另外，我认为变化在于我们所说的投入要素发生了转移。
subtitles.en: You know, also, I think the change is, that's what we talk about about inputs, inputs are shifted.

subtitles.zh: 我还认为，它将改变金融市场与实体投入之间的关系。
subtitles.en: And I also think it will change relationship between financial markets and the real world investment.

subtitles.zh: AI有点像双面手。一方面，构建模型需要大量人力资本。另一方面，它也非常资本密集。
subtitles.en: You know, AI is kind of Bob Bayer. On the one hand, it's a lot of human capital in terms of building a model. On the other hand, it's also very capital intensive.

subtitles.zh: 你需要大型数据中心、冷却中心和能源。
subtitles.en: You need a big data center, in a cooling center, energy.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着权益市场或风险投入，以及固定收益市场都能发挥作用。
subtitles.en: So that means both, you know, equity market or risk investment, and fixing come market can also play.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这是第二部分，它改变了金融市场与实体投入之间的关系。
subtitles.en: So that's, I think, the second part, you know, it changes the relationship between financial market and the real world investment.

subtitles.zh: 我的追问是，这在当前经济中如何体现？正如你所说，出口的很大一部分是AI。

subtitles.zh: 中国如何处理这笔出口收益？这些钱去了哪里？回流到了何处？

briefs.current_title: 经济学家：AI变革下，人民币升值天花板为何被压低？
current_title_lines: 人民币升值天花板为何被压低？

subtitles.zh: 第二是你关于汇率的问题。目前大约是6.7人民币兑1美元。
subtitles.en: Number two is your question on exchange rate. Right now, it's around 6.7 to 1 US dollar.

subtitles.zh: 很多人呼吁人民币快速大幅升值。由于AI变革，我的观点略有不同。
subtitles.en: There are many people calling for a very fast and big appreciation of the MNB. I had a slightly different view because of AI revolution.

subtitles.zh: 因为AI变革非常不同。因为它真正发生在服务业。更重要的是，在不可贸易的服务业，如医疗、教育和配送。
subtitles.en: Because AI revolution is very different. Because it's really happening in the service sector. More importantly, in the non-tradable service sector, such as healthcare, education, delivery.

subtitles.zh: 这些，你知道，它们无法出口，因为只在国内销售。所以如果这个部门生产率提高，又不能全球销售，实际上往往会降低成本，进而降低价格。
subtitles.en: This, you know, they can't give you, you know, because it's only domestically sold. So if you have a productivity increase in this sector, if you cannot sell globally, you know, it actually tends to reduce your cost and then also reduce you

subtitles.zh: 所以这实际上增加了通缩压力。所以在经济结构中，这实际上是巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应的逆转。
subtitles.en: So that actually adds a deflation pressure. So in the economic struggle, it's actually the reversal of bothersome effect.

subtitles.zh: 巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应意味着，许多发生在可贸易部门。它们的生产率增长快于不可贸易部门。
subtitles.en: The bothersome effect means that many happen in the tradable sector. They have faster productivity growth than the non-tradable sector.

subtitles.zh: 现在，我们看到了相反的情况。不可贸易部门的增长实际上快于可贸易部门。
subtitles.en: Right now, we have the opposite of it. The non-tradable sector is actually growth faster than the tradable sector.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，这压低了人民币的均衡汇率，从而降低了人民币升值的上限。
subtitles.en: So I think that we are pushed down the equilibrium exchange rate of the MNB and hence lower the ceiling of the MNB appreciation.

briefs.current_title: 经济学家：AI冲击就业，中国劳动力市场压力更大吗？
current_title_lines: 中国劳动力市场压力更大吗？

subtitles.zh: 你如何推断这对就业意味着什么？AI的冲击，对吧？考虑到经济相当依赖。你谈到的零工经济、配送等。平台。
subtitles.en: How have you started to extrapolate what this means for jobs? The AI disruptions, right? Just given that the economy is quite reliant. The gig economy you talked about delivery and the like. The platforms.

subtitles.zh: 你认为中国的劳动力替代会比世界其他地方更明显吗？是的，我认为全球来看，尽管我们看到对个体任务有很大影响，我的意思是，我们每天都用AI，
subtitles.en: Could the displacement of labor be much more pronounced in China than the rest of the world, do you think? Yeah, I think globally what you see is, even though we saw a lot of impact on the individual tasks, I mean, every day we use AI,

subtitles.zh: 但在总体层面，我们还没有看到巨大的替代。关于为什么会这样，有不同的理论。
subtitles.en: but we didn't see on the aggregate level a huge displacement yet. There are different theories about why it happened like that.

subtitles.zh: 一个原因是，你知道，你有许多不同的任务。有些任务很容易被替代，但整个工作更难被替代。
subtitles.en: One reason is that, you know, you have many different tasks. Some of the tasks can be easily replaced, but the whole of the job is harder to replace.

subtitles.zh: 但在某些行业、某些部门，例如编程、会计或初级律师工作，更容易被替代。
subtitles.en: But in certain industries, in certain sectors, for example, coding or accounting or junior lawyer job, it's much easier to replace.

subtitles.zh: 这在中国和美国都在发生。不是高级律师工作。不是高级职位。实际上，我认为对于进入就业市场的人来说，挑战更大。
subtitles.en: That's also happening in China in America. Not senior lawyer jobs. It's not senior job. It's actually happening, you know, I think for people entering the job market, it's much more challenging.

subtitles.zh: 所以这是一个全球现象，但不是在总体层面，那些已经有工作的人。他们越资深，我认为目前是安全的。
subtitles.en: So that's a global phenomenon, but not on the aggregate level, those people who already have the job. The senior they are, I think for now, I think it's safe.

subtitles.zh: 但我不知道，我的意思是，很难预测就业创造会发生什么。是的。
subtitles.en: But I don't know, I mean, you know, it's hard to predict what's going to happen for the job creations. Yeah.

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. - china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:

- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.

briefs.speaker: Yang Ming-Miao
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Economist and Senior Managing Director at SCICC; former Chief Economist at China State Administration of Foreign Exchange; former IMF economist
briefs.current_title: 杨明淼：5万亿新债发行，能否托住4.5%增长目标？

subtitles.zh: 是的，正如你所说，数据低于预期，但也在意料之中。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think, you know, as you say, it's below expectation. But it's also kind of expected.

subtitles.zh: 这就是你所说的结构调整，我一直称之为新兴增长引擎。
subtitles.en: This is what you've been calling a structural transition. I've been calling an emerging new growth engine.

subtitles.zh: 新引擎确实是由人工智能和新生产力驱动的，包括人工智能转型和绿色转型。
subtitles.en: The new engine is really, you know, AI and the new productivity driven. There's AI transitions, a green transition.

subtitles.zh: 所以，地产相关领域表现不佳并不令人意外。
subtitles.en: So it's not surprising that, you know, housing related items are not doing well.

subtitles.zh: 工业生产数据正如你所说，与出口一致，与新引擎相符。
subtitles.en: You know, the IP number, the industrial production, as you say, is consistent with exports, you know, with this new engine.

subtitles.zh: 某种程度上，这具有挑战性。你看，经济的一部分表现很好，另一部分则不那么好。
subtitles.en: I think, in a way, it's a challenging. You see, you know, one part of this economy doing very well at the other part is not so well.

subtitles.zh: 但对我来说，这也算正常。在如此大的人工智能变革中，你会预料到这种情况。
subtitles.en: But, you know, to me, I think it's also kind of normal. In such a big AI revolution, you would kind of expect that.

subtitles.zh: 话虽如此，我认为我们只剩下四个月了。
subtitles.en: That being said, I think, you know, we are only four months left.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，是时候拿出今年早些时候两会承诺的所有财政刺激措施了。
subtitles.en: I think, you know, it's time to bring out all the physical stimulus promised in the two sessions earlier this year.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，中国在未来三个半月可能发行近5万亿新债。
subtitles.en: I think they have, I think China probably has almost five trillion new bond issues for the next three and a half months.

subtitles.zh: 这比去年同期高出约1.5倍，约占GDP的1.1%。
subtitles.en: This is like 1.5 trading higher than the same period of loss. That's around like 1.1% of GDP.

subtitles.zh: 如果能做到这一点，我认为足以实现4.5%至5%的增长目标区间。
subtitles.en: If they can do that, I think it should be enough to meet the range of growth target of 4.5 between 4.5 and 5%.

subtitles.en: That's why, you know, the credit number is below expectation.

subtitles.zh: 然后，如果财政刺激加快步伐，
subtitles.en: And then, you know, if physical stimulus picking up pace,

subtitles.zh: 你应该会在传统领域和信贷数据中看到体现。
subtitles.en: you should show up both in the traditional sector, in the credit numbers.

subtitles.zh: 而且，政府刚刚提到了六张网。
subtitles.en: But also, you know, the government just mentioned six networks.

subtitles.zh: 所以你会看到从传统上刺激投资转向消费的转变，
subtitles.en: So you will see a transition from traditionally from stimulating investment to consumption,

subtitles.zh: 从硬基础设施转向更多软基础设施。
subtitles.en: from hard infrastructure to more soft infrastructure.

subtitles.zh: 我认为范围会更广。
subtitles.en: I think it will be more broader range.

subtitles.zh: 你提到新兴增长动力是人工智能。
subtitles.en: You mentioned the emerging growth driver is AI.

subtitles.zh: 那么，我如何看待这在经济中的表现？
subtitles.en: Now, how do I look at this play out across the economy?

subtitles.zh: 目前主要只体现在出口数据中吗？
subtitles.en: Is it mostly just going to be seen in the export numbers for now?

subtitles.zh: 你认为它何时会对增长做出有意义的贡献？
subtitles.en: At what point do you think it's just going to have meaningful contribution to growth?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，人工智能在前八个月占中国出口增长的45%。
subtitles.en: Well, AI accounted for first eight months, 45% of Chinese export growth.

subtitles.zh: 所以你已经看到出口增长。
subtitles.en: So you're already in export growth growth.

subtitles.zh: 是的。
subtitles.en: Yes.

subtitles.zh: 然后我认为你的意思是，从出口到国内投资，
subtitles.en: And then I think what you meant is really from export to domestic investment,

subtitles.zh: 当，你知道，我们经历的这个时期，30年后，
subtitles.en: When, you know, this period of we're going, 30 years from now,

subtitles.zh: 我们会回顾这一时期，说，这是传统经济与最终人工智能经济之间的过渡，

subtitles.en: Number one is that you say it's adoption and real world scenarios and very broad users.

events.candidate_system_prompt:
You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. - words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.

- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.

- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.

- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.

- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.

briefs.current_title: 经济学家：中国AI三大优势，如何重塑全球要素格局？
current_title_lines: 如何重塑全球要素格局？

subtitles.zh: 我认为中国在这场AI变革中或许有三个独特优势。
subtitles.en: I think China has maybe three unique advantages in this AI revolution.

subtitles.zh: 第一是应用落地、真实场景和非常广泛的用户基础。
subtitles.en: Number one is that you say it's adoption and real world scenarios and very broad users.

subtitles.zh: 第二可能是成本效率很高，开源模型、开放权重模型。
subtitles.en: Number two is maybe, you know, it's very cost-efficient, the open source model, open weight model.

subtitles.zh: 第三是基础设施和能源容量。
subtitles.en: Number three is infrastructure and then the energy capacity.

subtitles.zh: 传统上，如果发生重大技术变革，它会改变许多东西，改变你看待资源的方式。
subtitles.en: So traditionally, if you have a big technology revolution, it changes many things, it changes the way you look at resources.

subtitles.zh: 例如，第一次工业革命让煤炭变得非常重要。第二次则让它极其重要。
subtitles.en: For example, you know, the first industrial revolution make co- very important. Second, make it extremely, very important.

subtitles.zh: 我认为当前这一轮，不仅芯片重要，电力也再次变得重要。
subtitles.en: I think that's just the current one we make, you know, not only chips important, but also electricity important again.

subtitles.zh: 另外，我认为变化在于我们所说的投入要素发生了转移。
subtitles.en: You know, also, I think the change is, that's what we talk about about inputs, inputs are shifted.

subtitles.zh: 我还认为，它将改变金融市场与实体投入之间的关系。
subtitles.en: And I also think it will change relationship between financial markets and the real world investment.

subtitles.zh: AI有点像双面手。一方面，构建模型需要大量人力资本。另一方面，它也非常资本密集。
subtitles.en: You know, AI is kind of Bob Bayer. On the one hand, it's a lot of human capital in terms of building a model. On the other hand, it's also very capital intensive.

subtitles.zh: 你需要大型数据中心、冷却中心和能源。
subtitles.en: You need a big data center, in a cooling center, energy.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着权益市场或风险投入，以及固定收益市场都能发挥作用。
subtitles.en: So that means both, you know, equity market or risk investment, and fixing come market can also play.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这是第二部分，它改变了金融市场与实体投入之间的关系。
subtitles.en: So that's, I think, the second part, you know, it changes the relationship between financial market and the real world investment.

briefs.current_title: 经济学家：1.1万亿贸易顺差，回流路径为何彻底变了？
current_title_lines: 回流路径为何彻底变了？

subtitles.zh: 我的追问是，这在当前经济中如何体现？正如你所说，出口的很大一部分是AI。
subtitles.en: And I guess my follow-up there would be how that is showing up currently in the economy is in the form of, to your point, you know, a big part of the exports is AI.

subtitles.zh: 2000年代的上一次出口繁荣，大规模贸易，那些储备，我们看到它们回流到了美国国债。
subtitles.en: The last export boom in the 2000s, that massive trade, you know, all those reserves, we saw it recycled into U.S. Treasuries.

subtitles.zh: 中国如何处理这笔出口收益？这些钱去了哪里？回流到了何处？
subtitles.en: What is China doing with this export windfall? Where is that money going? Where is it being recycled to?

subtitles.zh: 我记得去年贸易顺差是1.3万亿美元。如果我没记错的话。这也是我的一个关键问题。汇率会怎样？
subtitles.en: I think we posted 1.3 trillion. If I'm not mistaken, last year in terms of the trade surplus. That's also a key question I have, really. What happens with the exchange rate?

subtitles.zh: 好，这是两个问题。首先，出口收益去了哪里？如果你看，我想对贸易顺差数字稍作修正，对吧？
subtitles.en: Okay, these are two questions. First of all, what happened to the export windfall? If you look at the, well, I want to slide correction on the trade surplus number, right?

subtitles.zh: 1.1万亿。1.2万亿是海关数据。1.1万亿是国际收支数据。但我们想讨论的是贸易流动。
subtitles.en: 1.1 trillion. 1.2 is like cost of data. 1.1 is the BOP data. But we all want to talk about motion that's a good trade.

subtitles.zh: 如果算上服务贸易，那就小得多。所以经常账户大约是8000亿。好吧，我记不清了。但那是次要的。
subtitles.en: If you can't services, that's much smaller. So the current account is like 800 billion. Okay, I lost it. But that's a little down the side.

subtitles.zh: 我认为去年发生的情况是，以前是通过央行，央行代为配置，对吧？
subtitles.en: I think last year, what happened is, you know, previously, it's recycling through central bank, central bank investment on behalf, right?

subtitles.zh: 或者私营部门，他们赚取出口收入但不换回人民币。所以我们有经常账户顺差，但没有来自境外的资金流入。
subtitles.en: Or the private sector, they make exports income to don't change back to the MNB. So we have a current account surplus, but we don't have flows from outside China.

subtitles.zh: 从去年开始，情况发生了根本变化。他们开始换回人民币。这就是为什么，记得我12月初在这里预测人民币会走强。
subtitles.en: Since last year, it has fundamentally changed. They started switching back to the MNB. That's why, you know, remember that I was here early December, calling for, there's going to be a stronger MNB.

subtitles.zh: 自那以来，我认为它升值了超过6%。今年对美元升值了4%。
subtitles.en: Since then, it has appreciated more than, I think, 6%. This year, 4% against your dollar.

subtitles.zh: 所以现在，我认为确实是中国企业、企业和家庭。他们在海外赚取外汇收入。他们汇回中国境内。然后从中国境内，他们再次配置到海外。
subtitles.en: So now, I think it's really Chinese companies, corporate household. They make foreign income abroad. They bring back onshore to China. And then from onshore to China, they're going to invest abroad again.

subtitles.zh: 他们会通过香港互联互通机制进入香港市场，或者通过持续的对外直接投资。好，这是第一点。回流路径已经发生了根本性转变。
subtitles.en: They're going to, you know, eat through Hong Kong Connect to Hong Kong market or through the ongoing overseas movement by FDI. Okay. So that's number one. How the recycle, the recycle has fundamentally shifted.

subtitles.zh: 第二是你关于汇率的问题。目前大约是6.7人民币兑1美元。
subtitles.en: Number two is your question on exchange rate. Right now, it's around 6.7 to 1 US dollar.

subtitles.zh: 很多人呼吁人民币快速大幅升值。由于AI变革，我的观点略有不同。
subtitles.en: There are many people calling for a very fast and big appreciation of the MNB. I had a slightly different view because of AI revolution.

subtitles.zh: 因为AI变革非常不同。因为它真正发生在服务业。更重要的是，在不可贸易的服务业，如医疗、教育和配送。
subtitles.en: Because AI revolution is very different. Because it's really happening in the service sector. More importantly, in the non-tradable service sector, such as healthcare, education, delivery.

subtitles.zh: 这些，你知道，它们无法出口，因为只在国内销售。所以如果这个部门生产率提高，又不能全球销售，实际上往往会降低成本，进而降低价格。
subtitles.en: This, you know, they can't give you, you know, because it's only domestically sold. So if you have a productivity increase in this sector, if you cannot sell globally, you know, it actually tends to reduce your cost and then also reduce you

subtitles.zh: 所以这实际上增加了通缩压力。所以在经济结构中，这实际上是巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应的逆转。
subtitles.en: So that actually adds a deflation pressure. So in the economic struggle, it's actually the reversal of bothersome effect.

subtitles.zh: 巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应意味着，许多发生在可贸易部门。它们的生产率增长快于不可贸易部门。
subtitles.en: The bothersome effect means that many happen in the tradable sector. They have faster productivity growth than the non-tradable sector.

subtitles.zh: 现在，我们看到了相反的情况。不可贸易部门的增长实际上快于可贸易部门。
subtitles.en: Right now, we have the opposite of it. The non-tradable sector is actually growth faster than the tradable sector.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，这压低了人民币的均衡汇率，从而降低了人民币升值的上限。
subtitles.en: So I think that we are pushed down the equilibrium exchange rate of the MNB and hence lower the ceiling of the MNB appreciation.

briefs.current_title: 经济学家：AI冲击就业，中国劳动力市场压力更大吗？
current_title_lines: 中国劳动力市场压力更大吗？

subtitles.zh: 你如何推断这对就业意味着什么？AI的冲击，对吧？考虑到经济相当依赖。你谈到的零工经济、配送等。平台。
subtitles.en: How have you started to extrapolate what this means for jobs? The AI disruptions, right? Just given that the economy is quite reliant. The gig economy you talked about delivery and the like. The platforms.

subtitles.zh: 你认为中国的劳动力替代会比世界其他地方更明显吗？是的，我认为全球来看，尽管我们看到对个体任务有很大影响，我的意思是，我们每天都用AI，
subtitles.en: Could the displacement of labor be much more pronounced in China than the rest of the world, do you think? Yeah, I think globally what you see is, even though we saw a lot of impact on the individual tasks, I mean, every day we use AI,

subtitles.zh: 但在总体层面，我们还没有看到巨大的替代。关于为什么会这样，有不同的理论。
subtitles.en: but we didn't see on the aggregate level a huge displacement yet. There are different theories about why it happened like that.

subtitles.zh: 一个原因是，你知道，你有许多不同的任务。有些任务很容易被替代，但整个工作更难被替代。
subtitles.en: One reason is that, you know, you have many different tasks. Some of the tasks can be easily replaced, but the whole of the job is harder to replace.

subtitles.zh: 但在某些行业、某些部门，例如编程、会计或初级律师工作，更容易被替代。
subtitles.en: But in certain industries, in certain sectors, for example, coding or accounting or junior lawyer job, it's much easier to replace.

subtitles.zh: 这在中国和美国都在发生。不是高级律师工作。不是高级职位。实际上，我认为对于进入就业市场的人来说，挑战更大。
subtitles.en: That's also happening in China in America. Not senior lawyer jobs. It's not senior job. It's actually happening, you know, I think for people entering the job market, it's much more challenging.

subtitles.zh: 所以这是一个全球现象，但不是在总体层面，那些已经有工作的人。他们越资深，我认为目前是安全的。
subtitles.en: So that's a global phenomenon, but not on the aggregate level, those people who already have the job. The senior they are, I think for now, I think it's safe.

subtitles.zh: 但我不知道，我的意思是，很难预测就业创造会发生什么。是的。
subtitles.en: But I don't know, I mean, you know, it's hard to predict what's going to happen for the job creations. Yeah.
